rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot's power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the tank's current energy must be strictly greater than the shot's power (no constraint applies if it doesn't fire).
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives, it must leave at least 80 pixels of free space: driving forward by a pixels requires the clearance ahead to exceed a by at least 80, and driving backward by |a| pixels requires the clearance behind to exceed |a| by at least 80 (no constraint applies if it doesn't drive).
clauses: r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a > 0 ==> (((around.clearance_ahead as int) - (a as int)) >= 80))
r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a < 0 ==> (((around.clearance_behind as int) + (a as int)) >= 80))

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules hold (S1, S3)
explanation.summary: Verus proved S1 (never fire a shot you can't afford) and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px). The battle logs list rule S2 as broken from turn 0, for 2 turns in the open arena and 34 turns in the city. S2 was not among the rules checked here and its text isn't given, so I can't say what it required or why it was broken.
